newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Atlas Copco Q1 profit seen 789.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Atlas Copco Q1 profit seen 789.

text.p: Swedish engineer Atlas Copco is expected to post a 1.7 percent fall in first quarter profit after financial items to 789 million crowns, a Reuter poll of 11 analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts ranged from 742 million crowns to 885 million.
In the first quarter of 1996 Atlas Copco posted a profit of 803 million crowns.
For the full-year 1997 analysts expect average profit of 3.36 billion crowns, seen rising in 1998 to 3.70 billion.
The average forecast for 1997 has been raised by 3.6 percent since a Reuter survey ahead of the annual report, when the average forecast amounted to 3.24 billion crowns.
Atlas Copco will present first quarter figures on Monday April 28.
Analysts interviewed came from Aros, Carnegie, Den Norske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Fischer Partners, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Nordbanken, Paribas, Penser and Swedbank.
